children: Turkey's unemployment rate rose 0.5 percentage points month-on-month to 8.1% in July, official data showed on Monday.

The Turkish Statistical Institute data showed the labour force participation rate decreased 0.4 points to 52.5 in July, while a seasonally adjusted measure of labour under-utilisation rose 1.8 percentage points to 30.6 % in July.
